name: Jilin Yatai (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Jilin Yatai (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the building materials business in China. The company offers clinker, cement, concrete, cement products, aggregates and slag powder; and medical devices and health management services. It also provides real estate development, construction, and property services.
